event_summary: A pink rectangular block is lowered onto a blue horizontal block spanning two upright blocks, then remains standing upright after the holder moves away.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a small block structure on a wooden tabletop: a blue horizontal block is positioned across a red upright block and a yellow upright block. A pink rectangular block, partly attached to or held near a dark and blue object above it, moves downward from the top of the frame at a slight angle. The lower end of the pink block reaches the top of the blue block near its center. The pink block becomes upright while its lower end is on the blue block. The dark and blue holder moves upward out of the frame, and the pink block remains standing vertically on the blue block. The red, yellow, and blue blocks remain visibly in place throughout.

reasons: The tabletop, blue horizontal block, red upright block, yellow upright block, and part of the descending pink block are visible.
The upper holding object is not yet fully visible in the first frame.
